TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD_GROUP_SRC
(
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUP_ID,
                CORP_REP_ID,
                CORP_ID,
                PERSONID,
                ORGID,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CONTACTID,
                SUSPECTID,
                PARTNERID,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDCODE,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDMASTERID,
                FLAG,
                SHAREHOLDING_IN_PERCENTAGE,
                TEXT1,
                TEXT2,
                TEXT3,
                DATE1,
                DATE2,
                DATE3,
                DROPDOWN1,
                DROPDOWN2,
                DROPDOWN3,
                LOOKUP1,
                LOOKUP2,
                LOOKUP3,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME,
                ORGKEY,
                ADDGROUP_ID,
                PRIMARY_GROUP_INDICATOR,
                GRPID,
                TMDATE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUP_ID,
                CORP_REP_ID,
                CORP_ID,
                PERSONID,
                ORGID,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CONTACTID,
                SUSPECTID,
                PARTNERID,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDCODE,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDMASTERID,
                FLAG,
                SHAREHOLDING_IN_PERCENTAGE,
                TEXT1,
                TEXT2,
                TEXT3,
                DATE1,
                DATE2,
                DATE3,
                DROPDOWN1,
                DROPDOWN2,
                DROPDOWN3,
                LOOKUP1,
                LOOKUP2,
                LOOKUP3,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME,
                ORGKEY,
                ADDGROUP_ID,
                PRIMARY_GROUP_INDICATOR,
                GRPID,
                TMDATE,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUP_ID,
                CORP_REP_ID,
                CORP_ID,
                PERSONID,
                ORGID,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CONTACTID,
                SUSPECTID,
                PARTNERID,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDCODE,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDMASTERID,
                FLAG,
                SHAREHOLDING_IN_PERCENTAGE,
                TEXT1,
                TEXT2,
                TEXT3,
                DATE1,
                DATE2,
                DATE3,
                DROPDOWN1,
                DROPDOWN2,
                DROPDOWN3,
                LOOKUP1,
                LOOKUP2,
                LOOKUP3,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME,
                ORGKEY,
                ADDGROUP_ID,
                PRIMARY_GROUP_INDICATOR,
                GRPID,
                TMDATE,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,
                BANK_ID,
                GROUP_ID,
                CORP_REP_ID,
                CORP_ID,
                PERSONID,
                ORGID,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CONTACTID,
                SUSPECTID,
                PARTNERID,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDCODE,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDMASTERID,
                FLAG,
                SHAREHOLDING_IN_PERCENTAGE,
                TEXT1,
                TEXT2,
                TEXT3,
                DATE1,
                DATE2,
                DATE3,
                DROPDOWN1,
                DROPDOWN2,
                DROPDOWN3,
                LOOKUP1,
                LOOKUP2,
                LOOKUP3,
                GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME,
                ORGKEY,
                ADDGROUP_ID,
                PRIMARY_GROUP_INDICATOR,
                GRPID,
                TMDATE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD_GROUP_SRC B ON A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
AND COALESCE(A.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

                SRC.TEXT1,
                SRC.TEXT2,
                SRC.TEXT3,
                SRC.DATE1,
                SRC.DATE2,
                SRC.DATE3,
                SRC.DROPDOWN1,
                SRC.DROPDOWN2,
                SRC.DROPDOWN3,
                SRC.LOOKUP1,
                SRC.LOOKUP2,
                SRC.LOOKUP3,
                SRC.GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME,
                SRC.ORGKEY,
                SRC.ADDGROUP_ID,
                SRC.PRIMARY_GROUP_INDICATOR,
                SRC.GRPID,
                SRC.TMDATE,
				SRC.FILE_DATE,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.BANK_ID,
				'CRM',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1
